AsyncResourcePlanOperationResult.description_en: The resource configuration plan of a deployment that works in expert mode
AsyncResourcePlanOperationResult.description_zh: 本数据结构代表专家模式的资源配置计划

message.description_en: The information about the ticket. The value of this parameter is returned when the value of the ticketStatus parameter is FAILED or EXECUTING
message.description_zh: 工单信息，ticketStatus为FAILED或EXECUTING状态时返回
message.title: 错误信息

plan.description_en: The resource configuration plan of the deployment in expert mode. The value of this parameter is returned when the value of the ticketStatus parameter is FINISHED
plan.description_zh: 专家模式的资源配置计划，ticketStatus状态为FINISHED时返回
plan.title: 细粒度资源值

ticketStatus.description_en:
The status of the ticket that applies for an asynchronous operation. Valid values:

EXECUTING

FINISHED

FAILED
ticketStatus.description_zh:
异步工单状态。
EXECUTING：执行中。
FINISHED：执行完成。
FAILED：执行失败
ticketStatus.title: 执行状态

AsyncResourcePlanOperationResult.title: 细粒度资源异步操作结果

description_en: Obtains the asynchronous generation result of fine-grained resources based on the ID of the ticket that applies for an asynchronous generation
description_zh: 根据异步工单ID获取异步生成细粒度资源结果
kebab_example: aliyun ververica get-generate-resource-plan-result --workspace a14bd5d90a0000 --namespace default-namespace --ticket-id 88a8fc49-e090-430a-85d8-3ee8c79c0000 --api-version 2022-07-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetGenerateResourcePlanResult

parameters.help_en: The ID of the asynchronous ticket. You can submit an application for an asynchronous operation to obtain this ticket ID
parameters.name: ticket_id

data.description_en:
If the value of success was true, the asynchronous generation result was returned.

If the value of success was false, a null value was returned
data.description_zh:
当success为true，返回异步操作结果；

当success为false，返回空值

errorCode.description_en:
If the value of success was false, an error code was returned.

If the value of success was true, a null value was returned
errorCode.description_zh:
当success为false，返回业务错误码；
 
当success为true，返回空值
errorCode.title_en: 当success为false时，该值不为空，表示业务错误码；当success为true时，该值为空。
errorCode.title_zh: 当success为false时，该值不为空，表示业务错误码；当success为true时，该值为空。

errorMessage.description_en:
If the value of success was false, an error message was returned.

If the value of success was true, a null value was returned
errorMessage.description_zh:
当success为false，返回业务错误信息；

当success为true，返回空值
errorMessage.title_en: 当success为false时，该值不为空，表示业务错误信息；当success为true时，该值为空。
errorMessage.title_zh: 当success为false时，该值不为空，表示业务错误信息；当success为true时，该值为空。
